header: How far the cable renewal has run in each district
lead: The programme replaces 640 kilometres of paper-insulated cable laid between 1958 and 1974. Each district is counted separately because each has its own contractor and its own ground.
note: Percentages are the share of planned cable kilometres laid, reported by the site managers at the end of December 2026. They are not surveyed independently.

metrics.title: Ashcombe
metrics.text: 134 of 146 km. The last stretch runs under the market square and waits for the spring closure.

metrics.title: Marrowfield
metrics.text: 79 of 129 km. Slowed by the rock under the eastern industrial estate.

metrics.title: Old Harbour
metrics.text: 31 of 113 km. Started last, because the harbour works had to finish first.
